description: Get posts from public Facebook Pages. Returns one row per post with date, text, reactions, comments, shares, media type, and link.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount. Summary rows are always returned.

pages.description: Public Page names or facebook.com addresses, for example NASA. Groups and personal profiles are not read. In Clay, put the column inside a one item list.

since_date.description: Optional date like 2026-01-31. Reading stops at the first post older than this.

name: get_facebook_page_posts
title: Get Facebook Page posts
